events.summary: A policy finding or exception request references Forge Shield organization-policy output. The evaluator records the affected finding without editing Forge Shield code, policy packs, or enforcement settings.
Retrieved SARIF/report evidence, policy-pack source, exception lifecycle state, owner, ticket, scope, expiry, and whether remediation is immediately available.
Generated two candidate playbooks: SARIF-backed time-boxed exception review, and blanket policy suppression for the affected category.
Accepted the evidence-backed exception review because it preserves finding details and lifecycle fields. Rejected blanket suppression because it bypasses policy gates and ignores expired exceptions.
Promoted only the read-only Forge Shield policy exception playbook. The evaluator does not modify Forge Shield code, policy packs, enforcement settings, release state, or live security posture.
